english.title: Cause assault / ill treatment / neglect / abandonment of child / young person to cause unnecessary suffering / injury
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who had attained the age of 16 years and having responsibility for **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE CHILD OR YOUNG PERSON..) a

(A)_[child]_
(B)_[young person]_
(C)_[child or young person]_

under that age, caused or procured the said **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE CHILD OR YOUNG PERSON..) to be assaulted, ill treated, neglected, abandoned or exposed in a manner likely to cause

(D)_[him]_
(E)_[her]_

unnecessary suffering or injury to health
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Children and Young Persons Act1933.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person 16 years or over having responsibility for a child under 14/young person under 16
caused/procured the child under 14/young person under 16 to be assaulted/ill treated/neglected/abandoned/exposed in manner likely to cause unnecessary suffering/injury to health

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 28th June 2022, due to an increase in penalty of the offence on indictment from a maximum of 10 years imprisonment to 14 years imprisonment by section 122 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022. For the offence applying before this date, see H2084.
(ii) Within the context of this offence a child is a person under 14 years of age.
(iii) See also offence wording: H100752.
(iv) Where the offence is alleged to have occurred over a period of time, it may be necessary to use option (C). This will occur where the victim, during the period of the commission of the alleged offences, grows from being a "child" to being a "young person".

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: maximum 14 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction was increased from 2nd May 2022, see section 32(1) of the Magistrates’ Courts Act 1980 as amended by section 282(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003. This applies only to offences committed on or after that date, see section 282(4). For offences committed before 2nd May 2022 the maximum penalty on summary conviction is six months imprisonment and/or a fine.
